Name: Mayo House for Alternative Textures
Author: TheFrenchDodo
Description:
Do you love mayonnaise? Do you think living in a boring wooden farm house is the worst? Well, this mod is for you!

Introducing the mayonnaise house for Alternative Textures!

This mod uses the power of Alternative Textures to give your boring farm house a bit of pizzaz. It includes the 3 variants of the house. The final upgrade will even use the duck mayonnaise colours to show how far you progressed!

Just use the paint bucket from Alternative Textures to give your farmhouse the mayo life it deserves!

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/699981232758325312/1018933806289399968/requirements.png[/img]﻿
This mod requires:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1050895834440540301/1122184287857430609/MCUBanner.png[/img]The MCU is a growing galaxy of unhinged mods with one common theme: Mayonnaise. This idea came to life after the release of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17122]The Unhinged Mayo Expansion[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/167786198]jayjaydub911[/url].
